1	# =============================================================================
2	# Paperclip — Cloudflare Workers deployment configuration
3	#
4	# After running `wrangler deploy` for the first time, fill in the placeholder
5	# IDs that Cloudflare generates (search for "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY").
6	#
7	# Quick start:
8	#   1. wrangler deploy
9	#   2. wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
10	#      Then paste the returned ID into [hyperdrive] binding below.
11	#   3. Open https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/setup to complete first-run setup.
12	# =============================================================================
13	
14	name = "paperclip-api"
15	compatibility_date = "2025-03-01"
16	compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]
17	main = "dist/worker.js"
18	
19	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	# Static assets — serves the React UI build from ui/dist alongside the Worker.
21	# not_found_handling = "single-page-application" makes CF serve index.html for
22	# any path that doesn't match a static file (needed for client-side routing).
23	# The Worker gets an ASSETS Fetcher binding to delegate non-API requests.
24	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	[assets]
26	directory = "../../ui/dist"
27	binding = "ASSETS"
28	not_found_handling = "single-page-application"
29	
30	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	# Variables (non-secret; override secrets via `wrangler secret put`)
32	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
33	[vars]
34	DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM = "cloudflare"
35	DEPLOYMENT_MODE = "authenticated"
36	DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE = "public"
37	
38	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	# R2 object storage — artifacts, skill bundles, attachments, DB backups
40	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
41	[[r2_buckets]]
42	binding = "PAPERCLIP_STORAGE"
43	bucket_name = "paperclip-storage"
44	# preview_bucket_name = "paperclip-storage-preview"
45	
46	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
47	# KV — sessions cache, hot config, first-run setup flag
48	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
49	[[kv_namespaces]]
50	binding = "PAPERCLIP_KV"
51	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
52	# preview_id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY_PREVIEW"
53	
54	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
55	# Hyperdrive — Phase 1: wraps Neon/Postgres for low-latency DB access
56	# After deploying: wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
57	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	[[hyperdrive]]
59	binding = "HYPERDRIVE"
60	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
61	localConnectionString = "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@127.0.0.1:54329/paperclip"
62	
63	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
64	# Queues — background fanout (cost rollups, activity log flush, plugin jobs)
65	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
66	[[queues.producers]]
67	binding = "PAPERCLIP_QUEUE"
68	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
69	
70	[[queues.consumers]]
71	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
72	max_batch_size = 10
73	max_batch_timeout = 5
74	max_retries = 3
75	dead_letter_queue = "paperclip-jobs-dlq"
76	
77	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
78	# Durable Objects — per-task state, per-agent-run state, scheduler alarms
79	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
80	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
81	name = "TASK_DO"
82	class_name = "TaskDO"
83	
84	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
85	name = "AGENT_RUN_DO"
86	class_name = "AgentRunDO"
87	
88	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
89	name = "SCHEDULER_DO"
90	class_name = "SchedulerDO"
91	
92	# DO migrations — bump new_classes when adding a new DO class
93	[[migrations]]
94	tag = "v1"
95	new_classes = ["TaskDO", "AgentRunDO", "SchedulerDO"]
96	
97	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
98	# Workflows — checkpointed multi-step agent execution
99	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
100	[[workflows]]
101	binding = "HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW"
102	name = "heartbeat-workflow"
103	class_name = "HeartbeatWorkflow"
104	script_name = "paperclip-api"
105	
106	[[workflows]]
107	binding = "PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW"
108	name = "plugin-dispatch-workflow"
109	class_name = "PluginDispatchWorkflow"
110	script_name = "paperclip-api"
111	
112	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	# Cron triggers — fire heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup
114	# Adjust intervals to taste; avoid high-frequency triggers (see CLOUDFLARE.md §10)
115	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
116	[triggers]
117	crons = [
118	  "*/5 * * * *",   # heartbeat sweep every 5 minutes
119	  "0 * * * *",     # budget threshold check every hour
120	  "0 3 * * *",     # DB backup daily at 03:00 UTC
121	]
122
